title: Sharonne wins España Season 2
summary: In the Grand Finale (ES-S02-E11), Estrella Xtravaganza, Sharonne, and Venedita Von Däsh lip-synced to Alaska y Dinarama's "Ni tú ni nadie". Sharonne was crowned Spain's next Drag Superstar.

title: Marisa Prisa: Season 2 Porkchop
summary: Marisa Prisa was the first contestant eliminated on España Season 2 (ES-S02-E01), lip-syncing to Gloria Trevi's "Todos me miran" against Samantha Ballentines.

title: Estrella and Marina double shantay
summary: In ES-S02-E09, Estrella Xtravaganza and Marina lip-synced to Jennifer Lopez's "El Anillo". Both won and no one went home.
